تقتادون (form VIII)
# تَقْتَادُونَ (taqtādūna) /taq.taː.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَادَ (iqtāda)
# تُقْتَادُونَ (tuqtādūna) /tuq.taː.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَادَ (iqtāda)
